sourceOfTruth: NormanAI-CRMx (SQLite). Research is discovery/qualify only — never scores Fit, never writes Notion as SoR.

verifiedPublicIntake.evidence: CRMx fail-closed evidence ingest (schema norman.research.crmx_evidence.v1). Research promote always passes --evidence; missing sidecar fails closed.
verifiedPublicIntake.csvContract: Crunchbase-export column names (Organization Name, Website, LinkedIn, …).
verifiedPublicIntake.richerIntake: Ordinary promote writes a versioned evidence JSON sidecar and passes it via --evidence.

fundingHandoff.csvContract: Full Crunchbase export headers (founded, HQ, industries, investors, funding fields, …). Unknown ≠ 0.
fundingHandoff.csvDropFallback: CRMx CSV drop folder remains offline/manual fallback only — not the primary watcher path.
fundingHandoff.notion: Projection via reconcile_sweep only. Research never dual-writes MACHINE props.
